The '''Rare Nova Crystal''' was an incredibly rare and priceless [[Nova crystal/Legends|Nova crystal]] that possessed strange healing powers. When held tightly, the crystal was known to rejuvenate the user's health, but couldn't be used again for a lengthy period of time.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rare Nova Crystal is an extremely rare loot drop in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. Unlike other Nova crystals, the Rare Nova Crystal has unique healing powers.<ref name="SWG" />
